tasks.title: Conversation #98
tasks.transcript:
Man: Did you hear about the new fitness class at the gym? It's an intense cardio class called cardio blast.
Woman: Yes, I did. I'm thinking of joining. Have you tried it yet?
Man: I went yesterday. It's intense but really fun. The instructors are great and keep everyone motivated.
Woman: That sounds perfect. I've been looking for a challenging workout. I'll sign up for the next session.

questions.stem: What kind of fitness class does the man mention?
questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：男士提到的是什么类型的健身课？ 定位原文：Man: Did you hear about the new fitness class at the gym? It‘s an intense cardio class called Cardio Blast. 选项分析： A. Gentle yoga 温和瑜伽。对话中未提及瑜伽，且男士明确说这是一门高强度课程，所以A选项错误。 B. Strength Training 力量训练。对话中未提及力量训练，所以B选项错误。 C. Cardio 心肺有氧训练。男士明确说这是一门“cardio class”（有氧课程），所以C选项正确。 D. Pilates 普拉提。对话中未提及普拉提，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What does the man say about the instructors?
questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：男士对教练说了什么？ 定位原文：Man: The instructors are great and keep everyone motivated. 选项分析： A. They are boring. 他们很无聊。对话中未提及无聊，男士反而说他们很棒，所以A选项错误。 B. They are inexperienced. 他们缺乏经验。对话中未提及经验不足，所以B选项错误。 C. They are motivating. 他们很会激励人。男士明确说教练“keep everyone motivated”（让每个人都有动力），所以C选项正确。 D. They are strict. 他们很严格。对话中未提及严格程度，所以D选项错误。
